Includes key identifying information and status indicators that allow users to quickly assess notification importance and take appropriate action. The summary focuses on actionable information while excluding large text fields and complex relationships that would slow down list rendering.

This DTO variant supports paginated notification lists, search results, and dashboard widgets where comprehensive notification details are not required but quick scanning and status assessment are essential for user workflow efficiency.

Valid values: unread (reset to new state), read (mark as acknowledged), dismissed (remove from active notifications). Users can update this field to manage their notification workflow and clear their notification queue.

delivery_method.description: Updated method preference for notification delivery. Valid values: in_app (application interface only), email (email delivery only), both (multiple delivery channels). Allows users to customize how they receive notifications based on their current context and preferences.

oneOf.description: Type of entity related to this notification for contextual navigation. Examples: post, comment, user, system. When provided, enables direct navigation to the related content from the notification interface.
Null value indicating no specific entity type association for this notification update.

Core notification content (title, message, notification_type) and creation metadata (created_at) cannot be modified through this DTO as they represent system-generated information. Security measures ensure users can only update their own notifications while preventing modification of critical system fields.

Optional related entity fields support notification context management, allowing users to update or clear entity associations when notification relationships change. All fields are optional to support partial updates following standard REST update patterns.

IDiscussionBoardUserBookmark.description:
Discussion board user bookmark entity representing saved posts for later reference.

Bookmarks allow users to mark interesting posts they want to revisit, creating a personalized reading list. Each bookmark establishes a relationship between a specific member and a specific post they want to save.

The system supports efficient bookmark retrieval and management, enabling users to organize their saved content effectively. Bookmark data also informs content recommendation algorithms by identifying posts that users find valuable.

Data required to create a new bookmark relationship between a member and a post.

This DTO contains only the essential information needed to establish a bookmark, with member identification handled automatically through authentication context. The system validates that the target post exists and is accessible before creating the bookmark.

Security considerations ensure that members can only bookmark posts they have permission to access, and duplicate bookmarks are prevented through unique constraints on member_id and post_id combinations.

The operation automatically timestamps the creation and handles soft deletion capabilities for proper bookmark lifecycle management.

IDiscussionBoardChannelStatistics.description:
Statistical breakdown of discussion board posts aggregated by channel.

This schema represents analytics data showing how posts are distributed across different discussion board channels. It aggregates data from the discussion_board_posts table grouped by channel to provide insights into channel activity levels, post volume trends, and content distribution patterns.

The statistics include total post counts per channel, percentage distribution across channels, and comparative activity metrics. This helps administrators and moderators understand which channels are most active and identify trending topics for resource allocation.

Each channel statistic includes identification information from the discussion_board_channels table along with aggregated metrics computed from the discussion_board_posts table. The data reflects only published posts to provide accurate metrics for user-visible content.

This statistical aggregation serves business intelligence needs for content analytics and platform performance monitoring, informing content strategy decisions and user engagement initiatives.

IDiscussionBoardPostStatistics.description:
Statistical breakdown of discussion board posts aggregated by status.

This schema represents analytics data showing the distribution of posts across different status categories (draft, published, archived, deleted). It aggregates data from the discussion_board_posts table using GROUP BY operations on the status field.

The statistics provide a comprehensive view of content lifecycle management, showing how many posts exist in each status state. This data is essential for content moderators and administrators to understand content distribution patterns and optimize moderation workflows.

Each status category includes count metrics and percentage distribution across the total post population. The operation performs real-time aggregation of post data, ensuring statistics reflect current platform state without caching delays.

This statistical aggregation serves the business need for content management analytics and moderation workflow optimization, helping inform platform health monitoring and content strategy decisions.

status_counts.description: Count of posts for each status category

total_posts.description: Total number of posts across all status categories

status_percentages.description: Percentage distribution of posts across status categories

IDiscussionBoardModerationDashboard.description:
Comprehensive moderation dashboard with aggregated statistics and metrics from multiple moderation-related tables.

This dashboard provides a holistic view of moderation workflow efficiency by combining data from content reports, moderation actions, and queue management systems. It serves as the central interface for moderation team oversight, enabling data-driven decisions about resource allocation and workflow optimization.

The dashboard aggregates real-time metrics including pending report counts, average resolution times, moderator workload distribution, and content violation trends. All statistics are computed through complex JOIN operations across the moderation tables to ensure accuracy without relying on cached data.

Security is paramount for this dashboard as it exposes sensitive moderation metrics. Access is restricted to authorized moderation personnel only, with appropriate authentication and authorization checks enforced at the API level.

IDiscussionBoardModerationOverview.description:

This component aggregates essential moderation metrics from the discussion_board_content_reports, discussion_board_moderation_actions, and discussion_board_moderation_queues tables to provide a comprehensive view of moderation system health.

The overview includes critical metrics such as total pending reports, reports processed today, average resolution time, and moderation team workload distribution. These metrics help moderators quickly assess system status and identify potential bottlenecks or areas requiring immediate attention.

All metrics are computed in real-time to ensure accuracy and reflect the current state of the moderation workflow without relying on cached or stale data.

IDiscussionBoardReportStatistics.description:
Detailed statistics on content report volumes, types, and trends over specified time periods.

This component provides comprehensive analytics on content reporting patterns by aggregating data from the discussion_board_content_reports table. It includes breakdowns by report reason, priority level, actor type, and status distribution to help moderators understand reporting trends and patterns.

The statistics cover multiple time periods including daily, weekly, and monthly trends to identify seasonal patterns, peak reporting periods, and potential coordinated reporting activities. This data helps moderation teams allocate resources effectively and anticipate workload fluctuations.

All statistics are computed based on actual report submissions and include both current period metrics and comparative analysis with previous periods to identify trends and anomalies.

As a computed statistical view, this schema represents aggregated business intelligence rather than direct database entity mappings. The metrics are calculated from underlying report data to provide actionable insights for moderation workflow optimization and resource planning.

The trend data is essential for capacity planning and resource allocation, allowing moderation teams to anticipate workload based on historical patterns and seasonal variations in user reporting behavior.

This component aggregates data from discussion_board_moderation_actions and discussion_board_moderation_queues to compute key efficiency indicators including response times, resolution rates, and workload distribution across the moderation team.

Efficiency metrics help identify bottlenecks in the moderation pipeline, optimize resource allocation, and improve overall moderation effectiveness. The metrics include both aggregate team performance and individual moderator efficiency to support performance management and workflow optimization.

All efficiency calculations are based on actual moderation activities and queue management data, ensuring accurate measurement of moderation workflow performance.

IDiscussionBoardQueuePerformance.description:
Queue management metrics showing workflow efficiency, assignment effectiveness, and potential bottlenecks.

This component analyzes data from discussion_board_moderation_queues to measure the performance of different moderation queue types and identify areas for workflow optimization. It includes metrics on queue wait times, assignment completion rates, and workload distribution across queue types.

Queue performance metrics help moderators balance workloads, identify bottlenecks in specific queue types, and optimize assignment strategies to improve overall moderation efficiency. The metrics cover both general queues and specialized queues for urgent, appeals, and escalated content.

Performance data is computed based on actual queue assignments and completion timelines, providing accurate insights into moderation workflow effectiveness.

IDiscussionBoardQueueMetrics.description:

This component provides comprehensive metrics derived from moderation queue operations, including wait times, completion rates, and workload statistics calculated from actual queue processing data. Each queue type has different performance expectations and handling requirements, so separate metrics are essential for effective queue management.

The metrics help moderators identify which queue types are performing well and which require optimization or additional resources. Queue-specific metrics support targeted improvements to moderation workflow efficiency based on actual operational data from the moderation queue system.

These metrics are computed aggregates that provide insights into queue performance, moderator workload distribution, and system efficiency across different queue types and priority levels.

IDiscussionBoardViolationTrends.description:
Trend analysis of content violation patterns, moderation outcomes, and platform safety metrics computed from content reports data.

This component aggregates data from discussion_board_content_reports and related moderation actions to identify patterns in content violations, effectiveness of moderation interventions, and overall platform safety trends. The analysis provides insights into emerging issues and moderation effectiveness.

The trend analysis helps moderation teams anticipate emerging content issues, evaluate the effectiveness of moderation policies, and identify areas where additional moderation resources or policy adjustments may be needed. It includes both historical trend data and predictive analytics for future violation patterns.

Violation trend data is essential for proactive moderation strategy development and continuous improvement of platform safety measures based on actual report and moderation action data from the content reporting system.

IDiscussionBoardModeratorPerformance.description:
Individual moderator performance metrics and workload statistics for performance management.

This component aggregates data from discussion_board_moderation_actions and discussion_board_moderation_queues to compute performance metrics for individual moderators. It includes efficiency metrics, workload statistics, and quality indicators to support performance evaluation and resource allocation decisions.

Moderator performance metrics help identify top performers, support moderators needing additional training or resources, and ensure balanced workload distribution across the moderation team. The metrics include both quantitative efficiency measures and qualitative performance indicators.

Performance data is computed based on actual moderation activities and is essential for effective moderation team management and continuous performance improvement.

IDiscussionBoardModerationStatistics.description:

It combines metrics from discussion_board_content_reports, discussion_board_moderation_actions, and discussion_board_moderation_queues to provide a holistic view of moderation effectiveness.

IDiscussionBoardReportVolumeMetrics.description:

This DTO provides essential indicators for monitoring report submission patterns across different time periods, helping moderators understand reporting volumes and detect potential spam or coordinated reporting patterns. The metrics capture daily, weekly, and monthly reporting activity to provide both immediate and long-term visibility into moderation workload.

The trend direction indicator allows for quick assessment of whether reporting activity is increasing, decreasing, or remaining stable, providing valuable insights for moderation resource planning and workflow optimization. Pending reports tracking helps identify potential bottlenecks in the moderation queue.

These metrics are crucial for maintaining effective moderation workflows and ensuring timely responses to user reports while identifying emerging patterns that may require additional moderation resources or policy adjustments.

IDiscussionBoardEfficiencyMetrics.description:

This DTO captures key performance indicators that assess the effectiveness and timeliness of moderation workflows. Response time metrics measure how quickly reports are assigned to moderators, while resolution time metrics track the efficiency of the moderation process itself from assignment to final decision.

The resolution rate indicates overall moderation effectiveness in handling reported content, while the escalation rate helps identify cases requiring specialized attention or higher-level review. These metrics are essential for maintaining high-quality moderation standards and ensuring timely responses to user reports.

Efficiency metrics help moderation teams identify workflow bottlenecks, optimize resource allocation, and maintain consistent moderation quality across different content types and reporting volumes. Regular monitoring of these indicators supports continuous improvement of moderation processes and user experience.

These metrics also provide valuable insights for capacity planning, helping moderation teams anticipate resource needs based on current efficiency levels and projected reporting volumes.

text: I'll create the E2E test functions for your discussion board. Let me execute the Test agent to generate comprehensive test suites for all the API interfaces.

scenario.draft: Test guest registration workflow for creating a new temporary guest account. This scenario validates that anonymous users can successfully create guest accounts without authentication requirements. The test should verify that a unique guest_token is generated using UUID v4 format and returned in the response. It should check that the guest record is properly created in the discussion_board_guests table with appropriate timestamps (created_at, updated_at). The response should include valid JWT tokens with proper expiration times for subsequent authenticated API calls. This test ensures the guest management workflow supports anonymous browsing while maintaining platform security and privacy requirements.

Test security aspects of guest token refresh mechanism. This scenario validates that token rotation enhances security by limiting the exposure window for compromised tokens. The test should verify that the old guest_token becomes invalid after refresh and cannot be reused for authentication. It should ensure that the new guest_token follows proper UUID v4 format and maintains the guest's identity continuity. The test should also validate that updated_at timestamp reflects the refresh operation, providing accurate audit trail for guest activity tracking. This test ensures the platform balances security requirements with user experience for anonymous browsing sessions.

dependencies.purpose: Establish guest account with initial token for security rotation validation

Essential authentication prerequisite:
This join operation (post /auth/guest/join) must be executed before any operations requiring 'guest' actor authorization.
It establishes the necessary user account and authentication context for the 'guest' actor, enabling subsequent API calls that depend on this specific authorization level.
